note: Single source of truth for SQC screens. FOUNDATION §3: user-facing navigation has exactly three entries (section first) — the complete accounting program (sector → company), audit, and helper tools. Reporting, analysis, Jev, settings and the standards library are cross-cutting layers: a screen lists the other entries it is shared with in "also"; it is never a fourth gateway. The legacy eight groups remain as internal studios/subgroups for compatibility, company scoping and deep links. Command palette, permissions and rebuild docs are generated from this registry.
